name: Suzuki T90 / T125 Wolf
engine: 89 or 124 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, Posi-Force oil injection
intro: Small two-stroke twins with a racy look. Quick and fun when the twin carbs are in sync.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
